session_reuse.description: Enable or disable session re-use support

rd_nb_stream.description: Default number of streams used for file transfers (0 = in-order-stream mode)

copy_checksum_type.description: Default checksum algorithm type used for transfer content verification

dcAU.description: Enable or disable the encryption for the data channel

spas.description: Enable or disable striped passive support

perf_marker_timeout.description: Maximum time between two performance markers (0 to disable)

delay_passv.description: Enable or disable the delay passive option of gridftpv2
